101.summary: What every Priest should know before choosing a spec: the Forever changes, the class quests, the baseline spells and the racial choice.

steps.text: Train Fear Ward and Devouring Plague at level 20, whatever your race. In Classic they were Dwarf and Undead racials.
Divine Spirit is a baseline spell at level 30 and Shadow Word: Death at 32, so neither costs a talent point.
Use Fade as soon as a pull turns on you: its threat drop is doubled.
Cast Prayer of Healing on someone in the group you want to heal. It now heals the target's party and their pets, not yours.
Renews from several Priests stack on one target, so two Priests can both keep Renew on a tank.

mistakes.mistake: Spending talent points on Divine Spirit or Improved Power Word: Fortitude.
mistakes.fix: Blizzard made both baseline, and the 10 Nov talent data no longer lists them in the Discipline tree.

mistakes.mistake: Looking for a Dwarf Priest to cover Fear Ward.
mistakes.fix: Every Priest learns Fear Ward at level 20 now.

steps.text: Do your race's Priest class quests at levels 10 and 20: Warcraft Tavern lists them as the unlocks for your racial Priest spells.
Human Priests unlock Divine Grace and Feedback, Dwarves Desperate Prayer and Chastise, Night Elves Starshards and Elune's Grace, and Gnomes Confounding Flash and Contingency Plan.
Read Benediction and Anathema as a Classic quest. It needs the Eye of Divinity from Majordomo Executus in Molten Core, and Molten Core is not one of the raids that open on 9 Dec.

mistakes.mistake: Planning a Benediction run from a Classic guide.
mistakes.fix: The Classic chain needs Majordomo Executus in Molten Core, which is not a 9 Dec raid, so it is unconfirmed in Forever.

mistakes.mistake: Skipping the level 20 class quest.
mistakes.fix: Your racial Priest spells come from the class quests at levels 10 and 20.

steps.text: Every Priest race trains Fear Ward and Devouring Plague at level 20. In the files Fear Ward lasts 3 min on a 3 min cooldown.

mistakes.mistake: Looking for a quest to unlock Fear Ward.
mistakes.fix: No quest is needed: every Priest race learns Fear Ward and Devouring Plague at level 20.

steps.text: A Human Priest gets +10% Spirit, which Holy's Spiritual Guidance turns into healing.
A Dwarf Priest gets +1% hit with spells and attacks from Artisan's Precision, which matters most to Shadow.
A Gnome Priest gets Eureka!, an 8 sec buff that makes non-periodic abilities 10% cheaper and stronger and also benefits Power Word: Shield.
The site holds no reviewed Night Elf racial bonus yet. Night Elf Priests unlock Starshards and Elune's Grace through their class quests.

mistakes.mistake: Choosing a Dwarf for Fear Ward.
mistakes.fix: Every Priest race learns Fear Ward at level 20 now.

steps.text: Shadowmourne is a Wrath of the Lich King axe for Paladins, Death Knights and Warriors. It is not a Priest item and not a Classic item.
Lightwell is gone from the Holy tree.
Binding Heal is gone too: Blizzard replaced it with Holy Binding.
Shadow Priests no longer raise a Warlock's damage: Shadow Weaving now boosts only your own Shadow damage.

mistakes.fix: Shadow Weaving now boosts only your own Shadow damage.

overview.lead: Discipline heals by preventing damage. Power Word: Shield is the centre: Soul Warding makes it cheaper and quicker to recast, Renewed Hope rewards healing shielded targets, and Divine Aegis turns critical heals into more shields.

points.text: Penance (row 5) is a 2 sec channel on a 12 sec cooldown that heals an ally or damages an enemy. Power Infusion, the tree's last talent, requires it.
Power in Light and Mental Agility improve Smite, and Holy Precision adds hit with Holy spells.

101.summary: Leveling as Discipline, the shield rotation and the mana habits that matter first.

steps.text: Power in Light makes Smite and Penance deal 2% more damage at rank 1 to targets with your Holy Fire or Shadow Word: Pain, which helps while questing.
Penance sits on row 5 of the Discipline tree and either heals an ally or damages an enemy.
Take Improved Power Word: Shield on the way down: Soul Warding requires it, and Renewed Hope requires Soul Warding.
Wand Specialization adds 13% wand damage at rank 1 and 25% at rank 2.

mistakes.mistake: Saving points for Power Infusion without taking Penance.
mistakes.fix: Power Infusion requires Penance.

mistakes.mistake: Looking for Force of Will or Unbreakable Will.
mistakes.fix: Both are gone from the Discipline tree in the 10 Nov talent data.

steps.text: Shield whoever is about to take damage. With Soul Warding, Power Word: Shield costs 15% less and its cooldown is 4 sec shorter.
Use Penance on cooldown for burst healing. It is a 2 sec channel on a 12 sec cooldown, and since the 8 Oct retune it stays more mana-efficient than Heal and Greater Heal.
Follow up with direct heals on shielded targets: at rank 1, Renewed Hope gives Flash Heal, Lesser Heal, Heal, Greater Heal and Penance 2% more crit chance on targets with Weakened Soul.
Each non-periodic critical heal leaves a Divine Aegis shield worth 5% of the heal per rank, absorbing up to 1,200 damage for 12 sec.
Save Inner Focus for an expensive heal: the next spell costs no mana and gets 25% more crit chance.

mistakes.mistake: Spending Inner Focus on Renew.
mistakes.fix: Inner Focus adds crit chance only to a non-periodic spell that can crit, so use it on a direct heal.

mistakes.mistake: Expecting Divine Aegis shields from Renew ticks.
mistakes.fix: Only non-periodic critical heals create the shield.

steps.text: Mental Agility makes Smite, Holy Fire and your instant spells 3% cheaper at rank 1.
Meditation keeps 17% of your mana regeneration going while you cast at rank 1, and 50% at rank 3.
Silent Resolve cuts the threat your spells generate by 10% per rank and also shortens Stun, Fear and Silence on you.
Mental Strength raises your Intellect by 2 to 10%.

mistakes.mistake: Expecting Twin Disciplines to help Greater Heal.
mistakes.fix: Twin Disciplines raises the damage and healing of instant cast spells only: 1% per rank.

overview.lead: Holy heals with Heal, Greater Heal, Renew and Prayer of Healing. Prayer of Mending, on the tree's last row, heals its target the next time they take damage and then jumps to another party or raid member.

points.text: Spirit pays off: Spiritual Guidance turns Spirit into healing, and the Human racial adds 10% Spirit.
Litany of Light returns mana when you alternate between different heals.

101.summary: Leveling as Holy, the core healing rotation and the habits that keep you alive.

steps.text: Holy Nova (row 3) damages enemies within 10 yards and heals party members within 10 yards, with no threat.
Searing Light requires Divine Fury and raises your Holy damage by 2% at rank 1.
Holy Specialization adds 1% crit chance per rank to your Holy spells.
Improved Renew makes Renew heal 5% more per rank, up to 15% at rank 3.

mistakes.mistake: Taking Searing Light without points in Divine Fury.
mistakes.fix: Searing Light requires Divine Fury.

steps.text: Keep Prayer of Mending on its 10 sec cooldown, on someone about to take damage: it heals them, then jumps up to 5 times within 20 yards.
Use Heal or Greater Heal for steady tank damage. Divine Fury cuts both casts by 0.1 sec per rank.
Alternate your heals: at rank 1, Litany of Light returns 5% of a spell's base cost when your previous heal was a different spell.
Put Renew on targets taking light damage; Renews from several Priests stack.
Cast Prayer of Healing on a member of the group you want to heal: it heals the target's party.

mistakes.mistake: Casting the same heal twice in a row and expecting Litany of Light's mana.
mistakes.fix: Litany of Light returns mana only when your previous heal was a different spell.

mistakes.mistake: Trying to keep Prayer of Mending on two players at once.
mistakes.fix: It can be on only one target at a time per caster.

chapters.title: Staying alive and casting through damage

steps.text: Blessed Recovery heals 8% of the damage over 6 sec at rank 1 after a melee or ranged crit, or after a single hit for more than 30% of your maximum health.
Spirit of Redemption (row 5) lets you cast healing spells for free for 15 sec after you die, and Prayer of Mending requires it.
Holy Binding heals you for 50% as much each time your Flash Heal heals someone else, and that healing makes no threat.
Twilight Focus gives your spells a 23% chance at rank 1 not to lose casting time when you take damage.

mistakes.mistake: Expecting Holy Binding to trigger on Greater Heal.
mistakes.fix: Holy Binding triggers only when your Flash Heal heals someone other than you.

overview.lead: Shadow deals damage over time and through Mind Flay. Shadowform, the tree's last talent, adds 10% Shadow damage, halves Shadow spell costs, doubles the crit damage bonus of Shadow spells and cuts Physical damage taken by 15%, but you cannot cast healing spells in it.

points.text: Vampiric Embrace heals your party for 20% of your Shadow spell damage, and Dark Inspiration raises your party's Spirit.
Shadow Weaving now boosts only your own Shadow damage, so Shadow Priests no longer amplify Warlocks.

101.summary: Leveling as Shadow, the core rotation and the Shadow talents that changed.

steps.text: Spirit Tap: after a kill, a 20% chance at rank 1 to double your Spirit for 15 sec, with 50% of your mana regeneration continuing while you cast.
Mind Flay (row 3) slows the target's movement by 50% while it deals its damage.
Fear Ward and Devouring Plague come at level 20 and Shadow Word: Death at 32, with no talent points.
Vampiric Embrace has a 30 sec cooldown and cannot be resisted since 16 Oct.

mistakes.mistake: Saving points for Shadowform without taking Vampiric Embrace.
mistakes.fix: Shadowform requires Vampiric Embrace.

steps.text: Keep Shadow Word: Pain up; Improved Shadow Word: Pain adds 3 sec per rank.
Cast Mind Blast on cooldown; Improved Mind Blast shortens that cooldown by 0.5 sec per rank, up to 2.5 sec.
Fill with Mind Flay and let it finish: with Improved Mind Flay each tick hits harder than the last, and a full channel triggers Dark Inspiration.
Use Shadow Word: Death to finish targets. A hit that leaves the target alive costs you 30% of your maximum health; a miss costs nothing.
Early Demise adds 15% crit chance per rank to Shadow Word: Death on targets at or below 20% health.

mistakes.mistake: Cutting Mind Flay short.
mistakes.fix: Dark Inspiration needs a fully channeled Mind Flay, and Improved Mind Flay makes each tick stronger than the last.

mistakes.mistake: Casting Shadow Word: Death on a target it will not kill.
mistakes.fix: A hit that does not kill costs you 30% of your maximum health.

steps.text: Shadow Weaving now boosts only your own Shadow damage: 2% per stack, up to 5 stacks, with a 33% chance per spell at rank 1 and every time at rank 3.
Silence needs no other talent first. It stops the target casting for 5 sec on a 45 sec cooldown.
Devouring Contagion makes Devouring Plague 25% cheaper at rank 1 and spreads it to 2 nearby enemies when the target dies.

mistakes.mistake: Expecting your Shadow Weaving to boost a Warlock's damage.
mistakes.fix: It now boosts only your own Shadow damage.

mistakes.fix: Forever data marks it 'No effect while in a raid instance'.

steps.text: Keep Vampiric Embrace up: it heals your party for 20% of your Shadow damage for 30 sec, on a 30 sec cooldown.
Mind Blast and full Mind Flay channels give you and your party 3% more Spirit for 10 sec at rank 1 of Dark Inspiration.
Stack Shadow Weaving yourself: it boosts only your own Shadow damage.
Icy Veins lists your raid utility as Vampiric Embrace, Dark Inspiration, the Prayer buffs, Psychic Scream, Fear Ward, disease removal, Dispel Magic, Mind Control and Shackle Undead.
Use Fade when you pull threat: its threat drop is doubled.

mistakes.mistake: Expecting Vampiric Embrace to heal the whole raid.
mistakes.fix: It heals your party members only.

steps.text: Silence stops spellcasting for 5 sec and interrupts the cast in progress for 3 sec. It needs no prerequisite talent.
Improved Psychic Scream requires Blackout and cuts Psychic Scream's cooldown by 2 sec at rank 1. Blackout gives your Shadow damage spells a 2% chance at rank 1 to stun for 3 sec.
Against a Warlock: Fear Ward is baseline for every Priest and lasts 3 min on a 3 min cooldown in the files, and Silence stops their casting for 5 sec.
Mind Flay slows the target's movement by 50%.

mistakes.mistake: Opening with Shadow Word: Death on a healthy target.
mistakes.fix: A hit that fails to kill costs you 30% of your maximum health, so save it to finish.
